_comment: TEMPLATE, AND A REAL GAP. This is the line the QA report is about: the jeepney that carries
people from the General Trias side straight through to SM Dasmarinas / Pala-Pala without a
transfer. It is genuinely missing from OpenStreetMap -- verified 2026-08-26 against the live
database, where the only services boarding at Bella Vista are SM Molino, Trece Martires, and
the two BT Vista Mall runs.
It is left as "draft": true because the intermediate stops below are a guess at the line, not
a survey of it, and a guessed stop list is worse than none -- it would put confident wrong
directions in front of a commuter. Ride the route (or ask someone who does), replace the stops
marked NEEDS SURVEY with what the jeepney actually calls at, set "draft" to false, and run:
The two endpoints and Pala-Pala are real stops already in the database, so those lines can
name: Jeepney: General Trias to SM Dasmarinas via Pala-Pala
notes: NEEDS SURVEY. Reported by a commuter 2026-08-26 as a single-seat ride that the app was missing. Stop list below is unverified.
